newsitem.title: UK: Bain Hogg chief to head Aon in Americas, UK.
newsitem.headline: Bain Hogg chief to head Aon in Americas, UK.

text.p: Ron Forrest, former chief executive of Bain Hogg and Alexander & Alexander, has been put in charge of U.S. insurance broking giant Aon's operations in Britain and North and South America.

Forrest, who was chief executive of British insurance broker Bain Hogg until it was acquired by Aon in October, becomes chairman and chief executive of Aon Risk Services Companies Inc, according to a company statement.
Patrick G. Ryan, chairman and chief executive officer of Aon Corporation, said he was delighted that Forrest had agreed to accept the new position.

"His extensive knowledge of the insurance broking industry and of the U.S. and UK commercial insurance markets, coupled with his achievements while leading the A&A retail operations and its globalization initiative, make him an ideal choice for this important role," Ryan said.
Prior to joining Aon, Forrest served for 30 years with Alexander & Alexander Services, Inc. (A&A), the U.S. broker bought last week by Aon.

He led A&A's retail operations throughout the UK between 1985 and 1989 before spearheading A&A's globalization initiatives between 1989 and 1991, and directing A&A's retail operations in the U.S. between 1991 and January 1994.
During that time, Forrest served as chairman and chief executive officer of Alexander & Alexander, based in New York.
In February 1994, Forrest became chief executive of Bain Hogg Group and oversaw the integration of the Bain Clarkson & Hogg entities before Aon acquired Bain Hogg.

Forrest will work alongside Dick Verbeek, chairman and chief executive officer of Aon Risk Services in Europe and Asia. Forrest will also represent Aon Group on the board of the World Insurance Network. --Reuters Insurance News +44 171 542 2770
